name: Horizontal Scroller
description: Pinned kinetic viewport camera that seamlessly translates horizontal cards in 1:1 synchronization with vertical page scroll (Brix Agency architecture).

props.name: itemGap
props.label: Card Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing in pixels between horizontal cards (default: 28px).

props.name: speed
props.label: Scroll Speed Multiplier
props.description: Scroll distance multiplier mapping vertical page scroll to horizontal translation distance.

props.name: showProgress
props.label: Progress Indicator
props.description: Display a kinetic telemetry progress bar indicating track traversal percentage.

props.name: showFadeEdges
props.label: Fade Edges
props.description: Show subtle gradient mask at horizontal boundaries for graceful card entry and exit.

props.name: fadeWidth
props.label: Fade Width (px)
props.description: Width in pixels of the left and right gradient fade masks.

props.name: fadeEdgeColor
props.label: Fade Edge Color
props.description: Custom edge gradient color. When empty, an alpha mask is used.

props.name: fadeEdgeColorDark
props.label: Fade Edge Color (Dark Mode)
props.description: Edge gradient color when dark mode is active. Falls back to fadeEdgeColor.

props.name: mobileMode
props.label: Mobile Mode
props.description: Mobile fallback behavior below 768px (scroll = native touch swipe with snap, stack = vertical list, pinned = retain pinned rail).

wordpress.description: WordPress Block Metadata for Exhuma Horizontal Scroller.
wordpress.code:
{
  "$schema": "https://schemas.wp.org/trunk/block.json",
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "exhuma/horizontal-scroller",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "title": "Exhuma Horizontal Scroller",
  "category": "layout",
  "icon": "columns",
  "description": "Pinned kinetic viewport camera that translates horizontal cards in synchronization with vertical scroll.",
  "attributes": {
    "speed": { "type": "number", "default": 1 },
    "itemGap": { "type": "number", "default": 28 },
    "cardWidth": { "type": "string", "default": "320" },
    "showProgress": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "showFadeEdges": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "fadeWidth": { "type": "number", "default": 48 },
    "fadeEdgeColor": { "type": "string", "default": "#ffffff" },
    "fadeEdgeColorDark": { "type": "string", "default": "#09090b" },
    "mobileMode": { "type": "string", "default": "scroll" }
  },
  "supports": { "align": ["full", "wide"] },
  "render": "file:./render.php"
}
